scope: complete 0-2399 arrival horizon with 2400-2405 closeout only

main_method.name: full_horizon_rolling_shadow_exchange::lagrangian_balanced
main_method.decomposition: 6-hour release blocks with a 72-hour bounded option horizon
main_method.decision_rule: real-time reservations are fixed; flexible task exchanges are accepted only when the declared balanced score improves, cost or carbon improves, and every minute-level hard constraint remains feasible
main_method.optimality_statement: bounded deterministic one-pass exchange; no global, MILP-optimal, or full joint-system optimality claim

baseline.name: full_horizon_FIFO_latency_feasible_local_first
baseline.construction: reserve all future real-time arrivals, then place flexible tasks by FIFO arrival order at the earliest feasible start with local-first latency-feasible regions

fallback.name: exact_minute_scan_unresolved_flexible_task
fallback.note: Candidate starts from the complete FIFO incumbent; rejected exchanges retain the old feasible row.

robustness.note: Fixed-schedule stress probes identify headroom boundaries and are not substituted for supplied-input feasibility.

limitations: The exchange evaluates a bounded 72-hour option set and can be locally dominated by a joint multi-task or exact full-horizon solve.
Hourly price, carbon intensity, renewable availability, fixed non-AI load, and static network latency are treated as known supplied inputs.
The problem specification excludes bandwidth, migration energy, and migration fees; they are not introduced.
Q2 does not optimize storage or grid exchange decisions; those remain Q3/Q4 interfaces.
formal_claim_status: proposal only; root review and evidence freeze required
